run_benchmark_compare: run a benchmark comparing the current directory against a baseline git commit for size and speed
run_GitWorktree: create a temporary git worktree at a given commit and clean it up after use
run_Run: execute a shell command and raise an error if it fails
run_Benchmark: build and run CPU benchmarks then output results in benchstat format
run_bloaty_compare: strip debug symbols and compare binary sizes between old and new builds using bloaty
